card.name: Sentence-opening "As" in descriptions
card.fires_on: The word "As" (or "as") starting a sentence or clause that describes an organization or thing, such as "As defined by" or "As its name suggests". Found in general web text about education, heritage and youth groups.

modes.label: Sentence-initial As
modes.description: "As" begins a sentence that defines or describes a subject, often after a period.
modes.example: Welcome to Architecture The built environment is part of our lives, shelters our activities and the historic, built environment supports our sense of identity.<< As>> defined by the Heritage Act, 1

modes.label: Clause "as" after a name
modes.description: Lowercase "as" follows a name and a comma, introducing a description of that body.
